title: Lead reconciliation
invariant: exactly one outbox event per submission; no stuck or inconsistent events

probes.name: submission-without-event
probes.message: contact submissions without an outbox event
probes.sql: SELECT s.id FROM contact_submissions s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM integration_outbox o WHERE o.aggregate_type = 'contact_submission' AND o.aggregate_id = s.id)

probes.name: event-without-submission
probes.message: contact outbox events without a submission
probes.sql: SELECT o.id FROM integration_outbox o WHERE o.aggregate_type = 'contact_submission' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_submissions s WHERE s.id = o.aggregate_id)

probes.name: duplicate-events
probes.message: submissions with more than one outbox event
probes.sql: SELECT aggregate_id, count(*) AS events FROM integration_outbox WHERE aggregate_type = 'contact_submission' GROUP BY aggregate_id HAVING count(*) > 1

probes.name: stuck-pending
probes.message: pending lead events older than 30 minutes
probes.sql: SELECT id, created_at FROM integration_outbox WHERE status = 'pending' AND created_at < now() - interval '30 minutes'

probes.name: delivered-without-timestamp
probes.sql: SELECT id FROM integration_outbox WHERE status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at IS NULL
